{"action":"done","summary":"All tests pass (220 passed). The existing implementation in src/cachetools/tagged.py already satisfies all requirements R01-R08:

- R01: put/get with deep copy, tag validation (rejects bare strings, non-string entries), deduplication
- R02: invalidate(tag) removes entries by tag, replacement updates tags, LRU eviction preserves correctness
- R03: maxsize validation (positive int, excluding bool), values cost 1 slot
- R04: invalidate_many(tags, mode='any'|'all') with union/intersection semantics
- R05: resize(maxsize) preserves entries/LRU order, validates input
- R06: Tags consumed once (generators work via list()), detached deep copies on get/put
- R07: Constructor accepts timer=None (default time.monotonic), put accepts ttl=None or finite nonnegative numeric TTL
- R08: Expired entries removed before get/put/len/resize/invalidation, TTL zero immediately expired, overwriting replaces expiry

No code changes were needed - the implementation was already correct and complete."}
